This beautiful boutique hotel surprises you with its original structure made from fine marble, natural wooden, precious materials and fine art interior decoration. All our rooms are welcoming, elegant and spacious. Warm cherry wood furniture… silks and natural linen…Italian marble bathroom... Here you can find all the essentials you need to unwind after a long day’s sightseeing in Hanoi and sleep like an angel on your heavenly bed. Maximize your pleasant of stay by enjoying a fine dining experience at Restaurant on Top with Lake View. Our attention to detail, high quality of service and Vietnamese hospitality guarantees a satisfying experience every time.
